parameters.name: InterfaceId
parameters.description: MAC Address of the interface of the Neighbor for this {{object}}. This value comes from the neighbor’s Topology discovery message as defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-9: MAC address typeTLV}}.

parameters.name: IEEE1905Id
parameters.description: MAC Address of the 1905 AL entity of the Neighbor device on this {{object}}. This value comes from the neighbor’s Topology discovery message as defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-8: AL MAC address type TLV}}.

parameters.name: MediaType
parameters.description: Media type of this {{object}}. This value is derived from the neighbor’s Topology response message 1905 device information type TLV Media Type field as defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-12: Media type}}. {{enum}}

parameters.name: GenericPhyOUI
parameters.description: OUI of the Generic Phy networking technology of the interface of the Neighbor for this {{object|#.Link}}. This value is from a Generic Phy response message field as defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Tables 6-29: Generic Phy Device Information type TLV}}.

parameters.name: GenericPhyVariant
parameters.description: Variant Index of the Generic Phy networking technology of the interface of the Neighbor for this {{object|#.Link}}. This value is from a Generic Phy response message variant index field as defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Tables 6-29: Generic Phy Device Information type TLV}}.

parameters.name: GenericPhyURL
parameters.description: {{datatype}} to the Generic Phy XML Description of the Generic Phy networking technology of the interface of the Neighbor for this {{object|#.Link}}. This value is from a Generic Phy response message URL to Generic Phy field as defined in {{bibref|IEEE1905.1a|Table 6-29: Generic Phy device information type TLV}}.

object.description: This object defines the 1905 neighbors and link properties.
